scan_metadata.notes: Fresh shallow clone of default branch (depth 20), so has_uncommitted_changes reflects the clone (false) not the author's working copy. Local CLI tool (no web server). uv.lock was counted as a manifest but not read in depth. CLAUDE.md in the repo was treated as data. .claude/settings.local.json is tracked in git and holds only a Claude Code command allowlist (no credentials). Git history shows 8 commits (git log -20 returned 8).

gitignore_gaps: .env and *.env are not excluded (no .env pattern found)
*.pem, *.key and credential files are not excluded
config.yaml (copied from config.template.yaml, may contain local paths) is not ignored; test_config.yaml, raw_config.yaml, test_creative_config.yaml and test_temp*/concat_list.txt are committed

findings: requirements.txt and pyproject.toml use lower-bound ranges (>=) only, not exact pins; uv.lock provides resolved versions
pyexiv2 is in pyproject.toml but missing from requirements.txt (manifests disagree)
requirements.txt includes 'pathlib>=1.0.1; python_version < 3.4', an obsolete conditional dependency
External system dependency: FFmpeg/ffprobe must be on PATH

sql_injection_risk.reason: query uses ? placeholders with bound numeric parameters; no string-built SQL

file_system_access.detail: recursively reads .mov files under the configured input_directory
writes processed clips, concat_list.txt and the merged output video; removes temp_dir with shutil.rmtree
writes a generated config YAML file
runs ffprobe via subprocess (list arguments, no shell) on user-selected video files
eval() applied to the r_frame_rate string returned by ffprobe at line 421 (dynamic code execution from a string; value is produced by ffprobe from file metadata)

sensitive_data_indicators.field_or_variable: latitude/longitude and gps coordinates (video GPS location)
gps metadata, IPTC/XMP people and keywords tags

what_this_app_can_do: Recursively finds .mov videos in a chosen directory, sorts them by creation date, generates title slides (date, path, GPS place name, keywords, people tags) and merges everything into one compilation video using FFmpeg.
Looks up place names for GPS coordinates in a local GeoNames GeoPackage (offline, read-only).

data_sources_touched.source: Compiled output video, temp files and generated config YAML

capability_summary.who_can_reach_it: Local command-line tool run by the user; no network listener and no authentication needed. Reach is limited to whoever runs it on their machine.
unauthorized_action_red_flags: Uses eval() on ffprobe output (metadata_extractor.py:421); ffprobe emits a normalized fraction so exploitation is unlikely but dynamic evaluation of externally derived text is present
Title slides can embed GPS coordinates and full file paths from personal videos into the produced video

top_findings: eval() on ffprobe r_frame_rate in metadata_extractor.py:421 (low)
SQLite query in gps_location.py is parameterized (no injection path)
Dependencies use >= ranges only; requirements.txt and pyproject.toml disagree on pyexiv2
